notes.title: 🎉 Entry Denied launches on June 19 with 40% OFF!
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]Entry Denied[/b] launches on [b]June 19[/b]![/p][p]After nearly a year in development, our atmospheric 2D point-and-click game is ready to open its doors.
You are an [b]undercover agent[/b], working deep inside the hotel, posing as a security officer.[/p][p]📦 Every delivery brings a new face. Some are just doing their job. Others… are hiding something.[/p][p]
🧠 Spot inconsistencies, uncover secrets, and make choices that affect the outcome.[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 At launch, the game will be [b]40% OFF[/b] for a limited time![/p][p]📌 Add [i]Entry Denied[/i] to your wishlist — and prepare to investigate the unexpected.[/p]
